## About StatQuest

StatQuest is a collection of interactive applets that make ideas in probability and statistics easier to explore. Each applet focuses on a topic I find interesting and lets you experiment with its key concepts, build intuition, and see the underlying mathematics in action.

## Applets

### Benford Distribution

Explore Benford's law and see why the leading digits in many real-world datasets follow a surprising, non-uniform distribution.

[**Explore the Benford Distribution applet →**](https://benford-distribution.vercel.app/)
